name: BLAZE XMD Skeleton
description: A modular BLAZE XMD WhatsApp bot skeleton for developers

SESSION_ID.description: Private WhatsApp session ID from your pairing flow.

OWNER_NAME.description: Display name of the bot owner.

NUMERO_OWNER.description: Owner WhatsApp number with country code, digits only.

DEVELOPER_NAME.description: Developer credit shown by the owner and bot-info commands.

CREDIT.description: Project credit shown in bot responses.

PUBLIC_MODE.description: Bot command mode: private or on for public mode.

ANTIMENTION_LIMIT.description: Maximum group mentions allowed before antimention removes a message.
